title: Security Signal
message:
%%%
## Goal
Detect an Impossible Travel event when two successful authentication events occur in a short time frame.

## Strategy
The Impossible Travel detection type's algorithm compares the GeoIP data of the last log and the current log to determine if the user `teacoroyalllc@gmail.com` traveled more than 500km at over 1,000km/hr.

## Triage and response
1. Determine if the user `teacoroyalllc@gmail.com` should have authenticated from `San Antonio, United States` and `Lubbock, United States`.
2. If `` should not authenticated from `San Antonio, United States` and `Lubbock, United States`, then consider isolating the account and reset credentials.
3. Audit any instance actions that may have occurred after the illegitimate login.

**NOTE** VPNs and other anonymous IPs are filtered out of this signal
